risks.description: Moving formal specs breaks a loader, test, or documentation reference.
risks.response: Use a specs-first compatibility loader, reference graph, legacy-path scan, schema validation, and compilation of all important flows.

risks.description: Runtime cleanup deletes local user data.
risks.response: Use git rm --cached only; keep local artifacts, workspaces, memories, and historical iteration files ignored and recoverable.

risks.description: Curated evidence is mistaken for delivery authority.
risks.response: Every promoted bundle carries a canonical status, limitations, reproduction command, and explicit support-only authority note.
